options.content:
Native OTLP metrics do not share an installation identifier with hook telemetry.
This dashboard can show native-signal freshness, but it cannot count installations
that have or have not configured OTLP export.

panels.title: Machines not seen on target version
panels.description: Installations in the fixed trailing 30-day cohort that have not reported the target version during that period.

targets.expr:
options(ignore_global_time_filter=true)
_time:30d
{service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"}
agent:!="selftest"
machine.id:*
NOT machine.id:in(
  _time:30d
  {service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"}
  agent:!="selftest"
  service.version:="$target_version"
  machine.id:*
  | uniq by (machine.id)
)
| stats count_uniq(machine.id) machines

panels.title: Inactive for more than 24 hours
panels.description: Installations in the fixed trailing 30-day cohort with no hook telemetry during the past 24 hours.

targets.expr:
options(ignore_global_time_filter=true)
_time:30d
{service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"}
agent:!="selftest"
machine.id:*
NOT machine.id:in(
  _time:1d
  {service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"}
  agent:!="selftest"
  machine.id:*
  | uniq by (machine.id)
)
| stats count_uniq(machine.id) machines

panels.title: Inactive for more than 48 hours
panels.description: Installations in the fixed trailing 30-day cohort with no hook telemetry during the past 48 hours.

targets.expr:
options(ignore_global_time_filter=true)
_time:30d
{service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"}
agent:!="selftest"
machine.id:*
NOT machine.id:in(
  _time:2d
  {service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"}
  agent:!="selftest"
  machine.id:*
  | uniq by (machine.id)
)
| stats count_uniq(machine.id) machines

panels.title: Native metric sample age
panels.description: Age in seconds of the newest client-provided sample timestamp during the previous 30 days. Client clock skew or replay can make this differ from time since server receipt.

panels.title: Stale installations
panels.description: The latest hook event for each installation that has been inactive for more than 24 hours within the fixed trailing 30-day cohort.

targets.expr:
options(ignore_global_time_filter=true)
_time:30d
{service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"}
agent:!="selftest"
machine.id:*
NOT machine.id:in(
  _time:1d
  {service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"}
  agent:!="selftest"
  machine.id:*
  | uniq by (machine.id)
)
| first 1 by (_time desc) partition by (machine.id)
| fields machine.id, _time, agent, service.version
| sort by (_time desc)
| limit 100

panels.title: Active installations by version
panels.description: Installations with hook activity during the trailing 24 hours, grouped by the latest observed version.

targets.expr:
options(ignore_global_time_filter=true)
_time:1d
{service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"}
agent:!="selftest"
machine.id:*
| first 1 by (_time desc) partition by (machine.id)
| format if (!service.version:*) "Unknown" as service.version
| stats by (service.version) count() installations
| sort by (installations desc)
| limit 15

panels.title: Active installations by harness and OS
panels.description: Installations with hook activity during the trailing 24 hours, grouped by the latest observed harness and operating system.

targets.expr:
options(ignore_global_time_filter=true)
_time:1d
{service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"}
agent:!="selftest"
machine.id:*
| first 1 by (_time desc) partition by (machine.id)
| format if (!agent:*) "Unknown" as agent
| format if (!os.type:*) "Unknown" as os.type
| stats by (agent, os.type) count() installations
| sort by (installations desc)
| limit 15

panels.title: Machine ID coverage
panels.description: Hourly share of hook telemetry events that carry an anonymous installation identifier.

targets.expr:
{service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"}
| stats by (_time:1h) count() total, count(machine.id) with_id
| math 100 * with_id / total as coverage_percent
| keep _time, coverage_percent

panels.title: Duplicate delivery rate
panels.description: Hourly share of delivered hook events whose delivery ID appears more than once.

targets.expr:
{service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"} event.id:*
| stats by (_time:1h) count(event.id) delivered, count_uniq(event.id) distinct
| math 100 * (delivered - distinct) / delivered as duplicate_percent
| keep _time, duplicate_percent

panels.title: MCP duration coverage
panels.description: Hourly share of MCP tool events that carry execution duration.

targets.expr:
{service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"} _msg:="mcp_tool_executed"
| stats by (_time:1h) count() total, count(mcp.duration_ms) with_duration
| math 100 * with_duration / total as coverage_percent
| keep _time, coverage_percent
